verdict.rationale: An independent probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.paddle.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and that file is itself cited as the source of SDK information. Paddle also publishes sectioned agent-oriented text files (llms/migrate.txt, llms/sdks.txt, llms/changelog.txt), .md versions of doc pages, and agent skills "written specifically for agents" discoverable at a .well-known index. On top of that, a docs MCP server gives agents current documentation, and a published LLM benchmark carries explicit agent instructions.
